issues.court: denied: actual knowledge of the items
issues.diagnosis: Innocent-spouse relief is not in the framework; the decisive step (knowledge) is a factual judgment.
issues.snippet: Petitioner is not entitled to relief under section 6015(b) or (c) because he had actual knowledge of the items giving rise to the liability.

issues.diagnosis: Multi-factor equitable weighing (Rev. Proc. 2013-34 §4.03); not a computation. Only the threshold allocation (3% / 97% of $20,174) is arithmetic.
issues.snippet: the Court is unable to conclude that it would be inequitable to hold petitioner liable for the tax liability.

notes: No deficiency proceeding. Omitted items 15,625 + 3,870 = 19,495 (97%) and 679 (3%) of 20,174. The $5,602 assessment's basis is not in the record (fn. 2), so it cannot be checked; the rest of the 2017 return is not in the opinion.

frameworkGaps.suggestedFix: out of scope; at most an allocation helper for §6015(c)(3)/(d)
